title: Invertible modules descend along affine transition limits
statement: Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed set, $(Z_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact schemes [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] that are quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], with affine transition morphisms $q_{ji}:Z_j\to Z_i$ for $j\geq i$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $Z=\varprojlim_i Z_i$ with projections $q_i:Z\to Z_i$ be its limit in the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], there exist $i\in I$ and an invertible $\mathcal O_{Z_i}$-module $L_i$ such that $q_i^*L_i\cong L$, where $q_i^*$ is the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].
